title: Input guardrails fail-open policy: offer a fail-closed mode for run-mode/autonomous skills
description: Raised by the sprint-237 audit dissenter (gpt-5.5-pro; payload in grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-237/adversarial-rejected-audit.4-exec-prompts.jsonl): the registry-rendered input_guardrails block (.claude/data/skill-includes/input_guardrails.md:13) continues when guardrails-orchestrator.sh is missing, exits non-zero or returns unparseable output. Pre-existing (identical at 80be4b0f, 'preserving pre-cycle-119 semantics'); the guarded text is the operator's own invocation, and the mechanical fences (hooks) do not depend on it, so the lead tallied it MEDIUM/confidence medium, not HIGH. Design question: should LOA_RUN_MODE=run treat orchestrator errors as BLOCK (fail closed) while interactive stays fail-open? Decide, then thread through the include + a bats case; no new config surface without a decision record.
